description:
'''Aḥwash''' ({{langx|shi|ⴰⵃⵡⴰⵛ}}, [[International Phonetic Alphabet|IPA]] /æħwæʃ/, also [[Romanization|Romanized]] as '''{{transliteration|ar|ahwach}}''' or '''{{transliteration|ar|ahouach}}'''), is a [[Shilha people|Shilha]] style of collective performance, including dance, singing, poetry and percussion, from southern [[Morocco]]. The ''ahwash'' is performed on the occasion of local festivals as a celebration of the community.

The central Moroccan counterpart is known as [[Ahidus]].
